_format: Core-checked wire data of the call indicator IPC (specs/007-call-mode-record contracts/ipc.md: the indicator://state and indicator://tick event payloads and the call_indicator_state reply) for the Playwright IPC mock, the same pattern as overlay-wire.json. Every state carries lang (en or ru: the UI language of the call; idle: the settings language). Each key is serde_json of the voicen_core::call::indicator value built as follows: idle_en / idle_ru = IndicatorState::idle(lang); recording_reminder_en / recording_reminder_ru = IndicatorState::recording(lang, true, []) (reminder and headphones hint rendered by Rust i18n::text); recording_no_reminder_en = IndicatorState::recording(en, false, []) (both texts empty); warnings_en / warnings_ru = IndicatorState::recording(lang, false, w) with w = IndicatorWarning::of(id, warning, lang) for the ids 1..8 and the warnings communications_device_differs, track_lost mic, track_lost system, mic_changed, cant_hear_other_party, cant_hear_you, low_disk, provider_notice host api.example.com; tick_levels = IndicatorTick {elapsed_ms 61000, mic_level 0.5, system_level 0.25, both silent false}; tick_silent = IndicatorTick {elapsed_ms 0, levels 0.0, both silent true}. Kept in sync by the core test e2e_call_indicator_wire_fixture_matches_core (crates/voicen-core/tests/call_indicator_wire.rs): when it fails, copy the value it prints. Never edit by hand to make an e2e test pass.
